integrity.claim_scope: All real parameters with nonzero sigmoid forcing, nonzero memory coupling and nonzero absolute-value gain; full real state space.
integrity.computation_limit: Finite numerical examples and exact rational tests do not establish an infinite-orbit claim.
integrity.evidence: Complete analytic proof in RESULT.md and standalone standard-library identity diagnostics in check.py.

scientific_limitations: Integer-order endpoint only; noninteger fractional-memory recurrences are outside the theorem.
The finite return-length constant is explicit but not proved optimal.
The theorem constrains bounded dynamics, but does not assert the existence, size, or basin of any chaotic invariant set.
Unindexed equivalent literature may exist; independent mathematical validation has not occurred.
title: Uniform sign recurrence and feedback-zero escape in a sigmoid-memory map
